observation.command:
echo "=== Image count (project images) ==="; docker images --format '{{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}}' | grep -viE 'ghcr.io|^[^/]*python[:@]|^[^/]*node[:@]|hello-world' | grep -v '^<none>' | sort | nl
echo; echo "=== Frontend artifacts ==="; for w in shared shell mfe-fp mfe-kp mfe-mp mfe-verwaltungsakt mfe-vp mfe-ws mfe1; do printf "%s:%s " "$w" "$([ -f /workspace/01-frontend/$w/dist/index.html ] && echo built || ([ -f /workspace/01-frontend/$w/dist/index.js ] && echo built || echo MISSING))"; done; echo
echo; echo "=== git status (modified files) ==="; git -C /workspace status --short | awk '{print $1}' | sort | uniq -c
